semiconductor_relevance: High — KINGSEMI Co., Ltd. is directly involved in the production and sales of semiconductor fabrication equipment, which is crucial for the manufacturing process.
summary: KINGSEMI Co., Ltd. specializes in semiconductor fabrication equipment, providing integrated solutions for substrate cleaning, washing, drying, and fab processing. Their product range includes bumping systems, track equipment for coating, developing, and resist processing, as well as etching, stripping, and ashing equipment.
capabilities: Track equipment for coating and resist processing
